lines: Today, Atticus is learning to be a big boy. Will you help him?
What shall we do? Tap a picture!
Let's do another one. Tap a picture!
Wow! Atticus did everything! Let's have a party!
Atticus is playing with his toys. Watch out for the wiggly feeling!
Uh oh! Atticus has a wiggly feeling. He needs a wee!
Uh oh! Atticus's tummy feels rumbly. He needs a poo!
Uh oh! I need a wee!
Uh oh! I need a poo!
Yes! Great listening to your body! Let's go to the potty!
Hmm. Playing won't make the wiggly feeling go away. Let's go to the potty!
First, pants down! Tap Atticus's pants.
Now sit on the potty. Tap the potty!
Now Atticus does a wee. Tap Atticus!
Now Atticus does a poo. Tap Atticus to push!
Next, wipe with toilet paper. Tap the paper!
Stand up, and pull your pants up! Tap the pants.
Last of all, wash your hands!
Tap the tap to turn on the water.
Now some soap. Tap the soap!
Scrub, scrub, scrub! Rub Atticus's hands to make bubbles!
Rinse the bubbles away. Tap the tap!
Dry your hands on the towel!
Back to playing! Watch out for the wiggly feeling!
Three stars! Atticus is a potty superstar!
I did a wee in the potty!
I did a poo in the potty!
First, a little toothpaste. Tap the toothpaste!
Just a little bit, the size of a pea!
Oh no! Sugar bugs! Brush them away!
Rub the toothbrush all over the teeth!
Now spit it out! Tap the sink!
Rinse your mouth with water. Tap the cup!
Look at those sparkly clean teeth!
All done! Atticus brushes his teeth every morning and every night.
This is Atticus's baby sister. Let's help look after her!
Oh no, baby sister is sad. What will make her happy?
Baby sister is hungry. What does she need?
Baby sister wants to play. Let's play peekaboo! Tap Atticus!
Baby sister likes gentle touches. Stroke her head softly.
Baby sister is sleepy. What does she need?
Hmm, not that one. Try again!
Her teddy! She loves her teddy!
Now pat her back. Tap baby sister!
A cosy blanket! Night night, baby sister.
Baby sister is fast asleep. Atticus is the best big brother!
Great job, Atticus! I'm so proud of you!
Baby sister loves you so much!
Hooray! Atticus used the potty, brushed his teeth, and looked after baby sister!
Atticus gets the Big Boy award!
Tap the house to play again!
This is Atticus. He's playing with his blocks.
Uh oh! Atticus gets a wiggly feeling in his tummy.
That feeling means he needs to go to the potty!
Atticus stops playing, and goes straight to the potty.
Pants down, and sit on the potty.
Atticus does a wee in the potty. Tinkle, tinkle!
Wipe, pants up, and flush! Whoosh!
Then he washes his hands with soap and water. Scrub, scrub, scrub!
When you get the wiggly feeling, go to the potty, just like Atticus!
Every morning and every night, Atticus brushes his teeth.
A little toothpaste, the size of a pea.
Brush the top teeth. Brush the bottom teeth. Round and round and round!
Now Atticus has a sparkly clean smile!
Atticus has a baby sister. He loves her very much.
When baby sister is sad, Atticus brings her teddy.
When she's hungry, Atticus helps with her bottle.
Atticus plays peekaboo, and baby sister giggles!
When she's sleepy, Atticus is very gentle, and very quiet.
Night night, baby sister. Atticus is a wonderful big brother.
